remaining_author_items.title: 小噪声证明搬移后仍指“上文的扰动界”

derived.source_line: For both schemes $\fro{\delta_{l+1}}\le(\lVert W_l\rVert_2+t\lVert N_l\rVert_2)\fro{\delta_l}+t\lVert N_l\rVert_2\fro{X_l}$ on every realization, since the entrywise ReLU is $1$-Lipschitz in the Frobenius norm and $I-\alpha P$ is a contraction; hence $\fro{\delta_l}=O(t)$ uniformly, and $\lVert\delta_l\rVert_2\le\fro{\delta_l}$. For small $t$ the margins of the teacher give (a), the quantized activations entering layers of positive strength have full row rank with singular values bounded below, and by the perturbation bound above $k_{l,c}\le\varepsilon_0+O(t)$. In \eqref{eq:defV} the source is $O(\varepsilon_0+t)$, so $V_{l,c}=O(\varepsilon_0+t)$. In \eqref{eq:defK} the source is $O((\varepsilon_0+t)t^2)$ and $\Psi_{l,c}(V_{l,c})=t^2\,D_{l,c}\Psi_l^0(V_{l,c})D_{l,c}=O((\varepsilon_0+t)t^2)$. The depth is fixed, so $\mathrm{tr}\,K_{L+1,c}=O(\varepsilon_0t^2+t^3)$.

derived.source_line: Not formalized: Theorem~\ref{thm:meansq} as an abstract conditional-expectation statement (the finite weighted version and the fixed-grid versions above are formalized); Theorem~\ref{thm:linear} for general error laws, where the integrability argument near singular Gram matrices is a paper proof; Proposition~\ref{prop:gain}, Corollary~\ref{cor:sched} and Example~\ref{ex:iso}, of which the first two were checked by exact enumeration on small networks and all three by the simulations of Section~\ref{sec:numerics}; the distributional property of subtractive dither on an unbounded grid for a general lattice, which we cite, and Proposition~\ref{prop:dither} for continuous dither; Theorem~\ref{thm:relu} as a statement about the actual stochastic network, Corollary~\ref{cor:hr}, the perturbation bound for projections and the weighted form of Proposition~\ref{prop:commute}; the expectation in Example~\ref{ex:noflip}, which is proved on paper in Appendix~\ref{app:noflip}; the energy statements for rounding with feedback when the parameters depend on earlier randomness; Remark~\ref{rem:piecewise}; the consequence drawn in Remark~\ref{rem:local} for an exact discrete minimizer; and the matrix family of Example~\ref{ex:proj} for general diagonal $D$. Verification consists of standard elaboration and kernel checking with printed axiom dependencies; no independent proof checker was run.
